invariants.text: Task.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a task is marked as completed, its is_completed field must be set to true.
When a task is deleted, it must be removed from the database.
The list of tasks must include all tasks that have not been marked as completed.
Adding a new task must create a new record in the database with a unique id, a description, and the is_completed field set to false.
The created_at field of a task must be set to the current timestamp when the task is added.
